description: Angular component for a dialog to configure alarm rule conditions in the Thingsboard platform, including form controls, validation, and script testing.

classes.name: CfAlarmRuleConditionDialogData
classes.description: Interface defining data passed to the alarm rule condition dialog component.

classes.name: CfAlarmRuleConditionDialogComponent
classes.description: Angular component for the alarm rule condition configuration dialog, managing form state, validation, and script testing.

methods.name: updateStaticValueValidator
methods.description: Enables or disables static and dynamic value controls based on condition type and mode.

methods.name: updateExpressionTypeValidator
methods.description: Enables or disables expression input and filters based on expression type.

methods.name: checkIsNoData
methods.description: Checks if filters contain 'NO_DATA' and adjusts form controls accordingly.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Adjusts form validators and control states based on selected alarm condition type.

methods.name: updateSpecText
methods.description: Generates human-readable description of the current condition based on form values.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Closes the dialog and returns the current form values as the alarm condition.

methods.name: onTestScript
methods.description: Triggers testing of the script expression and updates the form with the result.
